continuity: Ten thousand Dark Heaven faithful crossed into the Central Plains through hidden magic formations and joined the Green Forest Alliance and Yangtze River Channel League.
Most of Dark Heaven’s hidden magic formations retain one use; two or three used in the Shaolin attack may have lost their power.
The Blood Lord’s orders are to take Qinghai and, if possible, secure Jin Taekyung; he now orders an army to march on Xining.

The Blood Lord lied to the Lord of Heaven about his final fight with Mae Jonghak, claiming hundreds of exchanges; he privately admits he would not have lasted three exchanges had he known Mae Jonghak’s identity and conserved his strength.
plot: The Blood Lord and Grand Mage argue over his unilateral actions in Qinghai. He admits privately that he lied to the Lord of Heaven about fighting Mae Jonghak, then reveals his real plan: the advancing Green Forest Alliance and Yangtze River Channel League were bait and cover for testing Dark Heaven’s hidden magic formations. Ten thousand Dark Heaven faithful crossed into the Central Plains through the formations and joined the two alliances; most formations retain one use, though two or three used at Shaolin may be spent. The Blood Lord intends to march on Xining, while keeping the option to use the remaining formations for a larger invasion.
translation_decisions: Use “magic formations” for 마법진 and “Moving Formation(s)” for 이동진; keep the two terms distinct.

active_continuity: The Yangtze River Channel League and Green Forest Alliance are advancing west in a large combined force.
Ten thousand Dark Heaven faithful entered the Central Plains through hidden magic formations and joined the two advancing alliances.
Most hidden magic formations retain one use; two or three used in the Shaolin attack may be spent.
The Blood Lord’s forces are marching on Xining to take Qinghai; securing Jin Taekyung is a further objective if possible.
Mae Jonghak and the New Murim Alliance have prepared an operation against Dark Heaven; Zhuge Feng has the intelligence and tasking to execute it.
The Zhuge Clan is preparing to leave its current home immediately.
Zhuge Feng urged Jin Taekyung to hold on in the west.
open_questions: What is the black-robed captive in Qinghai’s identity and what does he know?
Why did the Lord of Heaven spare Taekyung in Gansu, and what is his real purpose?
Will the Alliance Leader and other righteous warriors reach Qinghai?
What is the hidden ember Cheongheoja warned about?
Who is the black-robed man beside Pa Ryun?

profile_creations.personality: Strategic and ambitious, with a sharp temper when others squander opportunities or act without consulting her.
profile_creations.relationships: Serves the Lord of Heaven and is an antagonistic peer of the Blood Lord, whose unilateral decisions anger her.
profile_creations.role: A senior Dark Heaven sorcerer who directs its mages and participates in its plans to conquer the world.
profile_creations.voice: Cutting and sardonic, using taunts and pointed questions to challenge others.

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Confident, cruel, and controlling; readily kills subordinates who disappoint him, but restrains his violence when preserving valuable sorcerers serves Dark Heaven’s goals.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Personality:** Confident, cruel, and controlling; strategically manipulates allies and adversaries, and conceals failures from the Lord of Heaven when he fears being discarded.
